title: Finn
franchise: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
description: Finn and Poe Dameron learned that Emperor Palpatine had returned and built a massive fleet, the Final Order. They undertook a quest for the Sith Wayfinder. After General Leia Organa's death, Finn and Poe become co-leaders of the Resistance. Finn led the attack on the Navigation Tower in attempt to prevent the Final Order from escaping Exogol's orbit.
